usedFor: Calendly knows when a meeting is booked and Slack is where the team hears about it. “New Meeting Book or Invitee Created” can post through “Send Message” to a channel, so nobody checks the booking page by hand.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting Book or Invitee Created” in Calendly, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: It fires as soon as someone books, and “Send Message” can post to a channel, user or thread, so the right person sees the new invitee straight away.

watchOut: An automation's post to a Slack channel waits for approval today, so the first message needs a tap. “When a meeting is scheduled, rescheduled, or canceled” is polling and runs on a schedule.
